summary: All three round-1 findings are resolved with assertions that now genuinely prove behavior (litmus-clean). The FAILED-path email check no longer leans on the uncleared Mailpit singleton: cleanAndSeed clears the JVM-wide mailbox and the test awaits getMessageCount()==1, then asserts the failed-template marker 'Спробуйте ще раз' and .doesNotContain('download?token=') — removing sendExportFailedEmail makes the await time out, and the test also locks the FAILED-branch orphan-blob deletion (removing the gridFsOperations.delete call leaves the partial blob and fails the isNull() check). The happy-path await is now ==1 against a cleared mailbox, eliminating the stale-message early-return flake. The customFields case was renamed to its accurate not-prefixed semantics and a new direct neutralizeFormula contract test proves a trigger-first value IS prefixed while a '{'-leading JSON object is not. The new unauthenticatedDownload_rejectedBySecurity_returns403 correctly locks the session-guard decision (matches SecurityConfig /api/** authenticated + SecurityBlockTest 403 precedent). No new flakiness introduced; coverage remains complete.

resolvedFindings.issue: Round-1: FAILED-path email assertion was hollow (only getMessageCount() >= 1 against the uncleared shared Mailpit singleton — passed on leftover messages even if no failed-email was sent).
resolvedFindings.resolution: FIXED. cleanAndSeed now calls MAILPIT.getClient().deleteAllMessages() (line 74). exportJob_internalError_writesFailedAndEmail awaits getMessageCount()==1 (line 140), fetches the HTML, and asserts .contains('Спробуйте ще раз') (failed-template marker, distinct from the ready template) and .doesNotContain('download?token=') (line 142). A new assertion (lines 147-150) verifies the partial GridFS blob is deleted on the FAILED branch.
resolvedFindings.litmusVerified: Remove emailService.sendExportFailedEmail from handleFailure -> mailbox stays at 0 -> await times out -> test fails. Remove the gridFsOperations.delete(...) at ExportSubscribersJob:245-247 -> partial blob persists -> findOne non-null -> orphan-blob assertion fails. Both prove production behavior.

resolvedFindings.issue: Round-1: happy-path email await used getMessageCount() >= 1 against the uncleared singleton, allowing an early return on a stale newest message (flake window).
resolvedFindings.resolution: FIXED. With the mailbox cleared in @BeforeEach, the await is now getMessageCount()==1 (exact), so it blocks until exactly the export-ready message lands before reading getAllMessages().get(0). Cross-test ordering dependency removed.
resolvedFindings.litmusVerified: Remove emailService.sendExportReadyEmail from finishSuccess -> await times out -> test fails. No early-return on stale messages remains.

resolvedFindings.issue: Round-1: formulaInjection_customFieldsCell_prefixed was effectively a duplicate control case — the serialized JSON starts with '{' so no neutralization ran; it never exercised the prefix path it was named for.
resolvedFindings.resolution: ADDRESSED. Renamed to formulaInjection_customFieldsObjectCell_notPrefixed with an accurate comment describing the whole-cell semantics. Added formulaInjection_wholeCellHelper_prefixesTriggerFirstChar that directly asserts SubscriberCsvWriter.neutralizeFormula('=DANGER()')=='\'=DANGER()' (prefixed) and neutralizeFormula('{"k":"v"}') stays unprefixed. neutralizeFormula is package-private static, callable from the same-package test.
resolvedFindings.litmusVerified: Remove the trigger-prefix logic in neutralizeFormula -> first assertion of the new helper test fails. The new test now catches a regression no other test catches; the renamed test documents the intentional whole-cell '{'-unprefixed behavior.

verifiedNewTest.name: unauthenticatedDownload_rejectedBySecurity_returns403
verifiedNewTest.assessment: Genuine. Locks the session-guarded download decision: no @WithMockAppUser, mints a VALID token, requests the download URL, expects 403. Verified against SecurityConfig (.requestMatchers('/api/**').authenticated()) and the SecurityBlockTest precedent (anonymous /api/** -> default ExceptionTranslationFilter/AccessDeniedHandler -> deterministic 403). Because the token is valid, the test isolates the security-filter rejection (not token verification).
verifiedNewTest.litmusVerified: Remove the /api/** authenticated rule -> anonymous request reaches the controller with a valid token -> 200 -> test fails. Deterministic security filter, no async/await -> no flake risk.
verifiedNewTest.note: The 403 (not 401) expectation is correct and intentional — pinned exactly so a future AuthenticationEntryPoint change reintroducing 401 becomes visible, consistent with SecurityBlockTest.

litmusTest.note: Re-checked: FAILED-email body marker + no-download-link, FAILED-branch orphan-blob deletion, happy-path exact-count email, neutralizeFormula trigger-prefix contract, customFields whole-cell not-prefixed, unauthenticated-download 403 security guard. All fail when the corresponding production code is removed.

pyramidBalance.note: API/backend feature — unit (SubscriberCsvWriter) + integration (export job, signed-URL download, refresh-URL) is the correct distribution per the test pyramid; no E2E required.
